NPLN.description: Named Plane (NPLN). TYPE selects the definition mode: TYPE 1 defines the plane from three points (POINT); any other TYPE defines it by a single coordinate offset (COORD) with tolerance (TOL).

TYPE.description: Plane definition type. 1 = defined by 3 points (uses POINT); 2 = X-Y plane, 3 = X-Z plane, 4 = Y-Z plane (each uses COORD as the plane offset). In the handler, TYPE==1 reads POINT; any other value reads COORD.

POINT.description: [TYPE=1] Three points defining the plane. Fixed-length array of exactly 3 point objects; only used when TYPE == 1.

ITEM.description: Point coordinates as [X, Y, Z]. Fixed-length array of exactly 3 numbers.

TOL.description: Tolerance for the plane. Relevant for coordinate-defined planes (TYPE 2/3/4).

COORD.description: [TYPE!=1] Coordinate offset of the plane along its normal axis. Used when TYPE is not 1 (i.e. TYPE 2/3/4).
